cards.mood: The piece opens with a majestic and solemn atmosphere, establishing a sense of historical grandeur through choral textures.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) and a Mixed Choir.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic anchor in the verses, playing arpeggiated figures that transition into block chords during the choruses.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solemn, majestic grandeur established by choral textures and heavy percussion, creating an atmosphere of ancient wisdom.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) and a Large Mixed Choir.
cards.palette: A full String Section (violins, violas, cellos) acts as the harmonic backbone, playing sweeping legato lines in the verses and driving staccato rhythms in the choruses, present from start to finish.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a majestic and solemn atmosphere, establishing a sense of grandeur through orchestral swells.
cards.vocal: The track features a mixed ensemble including Singer A (Male) and Singer B (Female), supported by a large choir.
cards.palette: A full string section (violins, violas, cellos) serves as the harmonic backbone, playing sweeping legato lines in the intro and transitioning to rhythmic, staccato ostinatos during the high-energy choruses.
